meta.description: Bus route verification log. Each route is marked as serving Tai Wai/Sha Tin or excluded. Verified against Transport Department ROUTE_BUS.xml / RSTOP_BUS.xml / ROUTE_GMB.xml (generated 2026-09-11, fetched 2026-09-25).
meta.provenance_note: The original 2026-09-21 pass relied on the KMB open-data API, which the checker could not actually access (ledger S11) - those verified flags were downgraded unless re-confirmed. Field-level evidence now comes from TD XML master rows (route, operator, origin, destination, full fare, LAST_UPDATE_DATE) and direction-specific stop sequences; see PROVENANCE.md S17/S18/S31. Headway fields are estimates: TD headway GTFS (S20) expresses variable frequency bands that a single number cannot safely summarise.
